name: Boon of the Night Spirit
desc: +1 to an ability score (maximum 30). Merge with Shadows: while within Dim Light or Darkness, you can take a Bonus Action to become Invisible until you take an action, a Bonus Action or a Reaction. Shadowy Form: while within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

effects.note: In Dim Light or Darkness: Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant
